rules.when: Routine documentation, config changes, simple fixes, README updates, or straightforward boilerplate work
rules.why: Fable handles routine work well at lower cost; saves opus headroom for complex tasks

rules.when: Bug investigation, reproduction, diagnostic reasoning, or codebase exploration that needs careful analysis
rules.why: Fable at xhigh for investigation; strong reasoning without burning opus quota

rules.when: Complex implementation, architecture decisions, security-sensitive work, multi-file refactors, or anything requiring deep reasoning
rules.why: Opus for work that demands the strongest reasoning

rules.when: Scout investigation, codebase audit, security scan, or research task that produces a report without changing code
rules.why: Scouts are read-only; fable handles research well

_comment: NO ROUTERS. Every spawn is omp talking straight to Anthropic through omp's own anthropic provider (model ids anthropic/claude-*), authenticated interactively on the account that runs the fleet. Account rotation is native to omp: it pools several accounts of the same provider itself, so needing more than one account is never a reason to reintroduce a gateway. A router, gateway, or gateway-prefixed model id comes back only by explicit operator decision. Harness is omp, not the claude CLI.
